# Libraries 
```{r load libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggh4x)
library(flextable)
```

# Import data
```{r DEG counts}
# DEG Counts table from Deduplicated DF
DEG_counts <- read.delim('data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/2025-06-03_DECalc_deduped-data.tab')  

# Add Metadata to DEG_counts and clean up
DEG_counts_df <- DEG_counts %>% 
  mutate(SitevSite = 
          case_when(grepl("resIn", Contrast) & grepl("vIn", Contrast) ~
                      "InvIn",
                    grepl("resIn", Contrast) & grepl("vOff", Contrast) ~
                      "InvOff",
                    grepl("resOff", Contrast) & grepl("vIn", Contrast) ~
                      "OffvIn",
                    grepl("resOff", Contrast) & grepl("vOff", Contrast) ~
                      "OffvOff")) %>%
  mutate(Trial = "deduped") %>%
  
  # Extract the first T# after resOff or resIn, including the "T"
  mutate(TP1 = str_extract(Contrast, "T\\d+(?=v)")) %>%
 
   # Extract the last two characters of the string, 
  mutate(TP2 = str_sub(Contrast, -2, -1)) %>%
  mutate(Temp = str_sub(Contrast, -5, -4)) %>%
  mutate(TP1 = case_when(Contrast == "resInvOffT0" ~ "T0", 
                         TRUE ~ TP1),
         Temp = case_when(Contrast == "resInvOffT0" ~ "T0",
                          TRUE ~ Temp)) %>%
  mutate(Site = case_when(SitevSite == "InvIn" ~ "Inshore",
                          SitevSite == "OffvOff" ~ "Offshore",
                          SitevSite == "InvOff" | SitevSite == "OffvIn" ~
                            "Across_Sites"))
```

```{r}
# Create long form dataframe 
DEG_counts_df_long <- DEG_counts_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-SitevSite) %>%
  gather(key = DEG, value = counts, -Contrast, -Site, 
         -TP1, -TP2, -Temp, -Trial) %>%
  filter(Site == "Across_Sites") %>%
  filter(DEG != "TotalNumDEGs") %>%
  filter(Temp != 30) %>%
  filter(TP1 != "T0")
```

```{r}
ggplot(DEG_counts_df_long, aes(x = TP1, y = counts, fill = DEG)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") + 
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Down-regulated", "Up-regulated"), 
                    values = c("gray60", "gray30")) +
  ggtitle("Offshore vs Inshore DEGs at 34C") +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("# of DEGs") +
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent"),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0, unit = "pt"), 
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 10, l = 5))

```

```{r}
DEG_counts_df_long_control <- DEG_counts_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-SitevSite) %>%
  gather(key = DEG, value = counts, -Contrast, -Site, 
         -TP1, -TP2, -Temp, -Trial) %>%
  filter(Site == "Across_Sites") %>%
  filter(DEG != "TotalNumDEGs")  %>%
  filter(Temp == 30)

ggplot(DEG_counts_df_long_control, aes(x = TP1, y = counts, fill = DEG)) +

        legend.title = element_blank(),

        axis.ticks = element_blank(),

        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 11),
        panel.spacing.x = unit(0.1, "lines"),

        legend.margin = margin(t = -5, b = 0, unit = "pt"), 
        plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 10, l = 5))
```

```{r}
OffvIn_T3_34 <- read.delim('data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/resOff_34_T3vIn_34_T3.txt') %>%
  filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj))

In_T3_30v34 <- read.delim('data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/resIn_30_T3vIn_34_T3.txt') %>%
  filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj))

Off_T3_30v34 <- read.delim('data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/resOff_30_T3vOff_34_T3.txt')  %>%
  filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj))

overlap_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(OffvIn_T3_34),
  rownames(Off_T3_30v34))

length(overlap_genes)

overlap_df <- OffvIn_T3_34[overlap_genes, ] %>%
  select(log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
  rename(
    log2FC_OffvIn = log2FoldChange,
    padj_OffvIn = padj
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(
    Off_T3_30v34[overlap_genes, ] %>%
      select(log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
      rename(
        log2FC_Offv30v34 = log2FoldChange,
        padj_Offv30v34 = padj))

setdiff(rownames(Off_T3_30v34), rownames(overlap_df))

setdiff(rownames(In_T3_30v34), rownames(Off_T3_30v34))

Off_unique <- setdiff(
  rownames(Off_T3_30v34),
  rownames(In_T3_30v34))

length(Off_unique)

length(overlap_genes) / nrow(OffvIn_T3_34) * 100

table(
  sign(overlap_df$log2FC_OffvIn) ==
  sign(overlap_df$log2FC_Offv30v34)
)

```
